whatIs: Best Website Gallery is a hand-picked selection by David Hellmann of more than 2,600 websites published since 2008. Each new entry appears as Site of the Day, and there's also a links section with articles and tools.
You browse by sites, links and tags, with a search bar. It's a good fit when you want to see quality web design with editorial judgment, not a massive dump.
uses: Checking the Site of the Day to pick up on current typography and layout trends.
Looking for examples of portfolios or agency sites before redesigning yours.
Using the links section to discover web design articles and tools.
caveats: Entries aren't published daily; the pace is irregular.
It shows only screenshots and credits; it doesn't explain how each site is built.
The selection reflects one person's taste.
idealFor: Web design inspiration with an editorial selection.
